title: Forks and mast
description: Inspect for cracks, bends, proper chain tension, and hydraulic leaks.

title: Tires and wheels
description: Check tire pressure, tread wear, cuts, chunking, and missing lug nuts.

title: Brakes
description: Test service brakes, parking brake, and emergency deadman switch.

title: Steering
description: Verify smooth steering response with no excessive play or binding.

title: Warning devices
description: Verify horn, reverse backup alarm, strobe light, and headlights.
note: Backup alarm volume low, scheduled for review

title: Seat belt / restraint
description: Ensure seat belt latches securely, retracts smoothly, and webbing is intact.
